'''Dramath the Second''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the ancient [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. Dramath the Second was the son of [[Dramath]] the elder, who ruled the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Nathema|Medriaas]] prior to the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]].

==Biography==
During his father's reign, villages on Medriaas began falling to the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] youth [[Tenebrae]], who eventually gained enough power to [[Medriaas revolution|challenge]] Dramath the elder for the right to rule the world.<ref name="Revan" />

Unbeknownst to many at the time, [[Tenebrae]] was, in fact, the elder Dramath's illegitimate son, and therefore Dramath the Second's half-brother. After killing their father, Tenebrae sought to destroy Dramath the Second as well, but the Sith Lord fled Medriaas with a group of followers, and made a new life on the snow-swept world of [[Rekkiad]].<ref name="Revan" />

Dramath the Second eventually died on Rekkiad, and his disciples entombed him in a hidden [[Dramath the Second's tomb|crypt]] found in the first of the two plateaus that comprised the [[Twin Spears]]. In [[3978 BBY]], [[Mandalore the Ultimate]] led Tenebrae's [[Unidentified Sith emissary|emissary]] to Dramath the Second's crypt.<ref name="Revan" />
